dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:ubunturesolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG AUDACITY_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="aptalca"

# title
ENV TITLE=Audacity \
    NO_GAMEPAD=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/audacity-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y \
    python3-xdg \
    libatk1.0 \
    libatk-bridge2.0 \
    libnss3 \
    libportaudio2 && \
  echo "**** install audacity ****" && \
  if [ -z ${AUDACITY_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    AUDACITY_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/audacity/audacity/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name' | sed 's|^Audacity-||'); \
  fi && \
  cd /tmp && \
  curl -fo \
    /tmp/audacity.app -L \
    "https://github.com/audacity/audacity/releases/download/Audacity-${AUDACITY_VERSION}/audacity-linux-${AUDACITY_VERSION}-x86_64.AppImage" && \
  chmod +x /tmp/audacity.app && \
  ./audacity.app --appimage-extract && \
  mv squashfs-root /opt/audacity && \
  ln -s \
    /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libportaudio.so.2 \
    /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libportaudio.so && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  find /opt/audacity -type d -exec chmod 755 {} + && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001

VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
# Audacity 4.0.1 release notes

Many of these fixes come from community contributors. Thank you all!

## Features

- Export multiple: export each track, or each labelled region, to its own file (#11136)
- Portable Windows version that runs without installation (#11932)
- Restored missing Audacity 3 keyboard shortcuts (#12062)
- "Open in file manager" on the Cloud projects tab (#11801)
- Clickable carousel dots on the Welcome screen (#11247, by @danielmolinas)
- Liquid Glass app icon on macOS (#11923, by @JoshBashed)

## Accessibility

- The timeline and the track vertical rulers are now part of keyboard navigation (#11367, #11368)
- Opening the Effects panel focuses the "Add effect" button (#11416)
- Toast notifications are announced by screen readers and reachable by keyboard (#11645)

## Bug fixes

- Fixed project corruption after a failed save (#12296)
- Fixed clips being messed up when converting .aup3 projects (#12209)
- Fixed opening projects and files with non-ASCII characters in their name or folder (#11973, #11976, #12004, #12057, by @jonata)
- Fixed other non-ASCII text issues: presets with Unicode names, starting a new project, and the input device always being the system default on Windows (#8267, #11468, #12107)
- Fixed Audacity failing to launch with Windows Smart App Control enabled (#12167)
- Fixed the AppImage failing to install or start on some Linux distributions (#10135, #12093, by @kfl; #11915)
- Fixed crash when opening the Effect menu in German (#12025)
- Fixed "Audacity quit unexpectedly" dialogs popping up during plugin validation (#11427)
- Fixed VST3 setting changes being reverted on playback start (#11892)
- Fixed typing values into effect controls (#11643, #11668)
- Dragging clips and labels across tracks is faster and no longer crashes, and dragging a duplicated clip onto its original no longer makes it disappear (#12097, #12081 by @jonata)
- Realtime effect windows stay open on edits and undo/redo, and undo/redo is faster with many effects (#12187)
- Fixed clips flickering when selecting after applying an effect (#11145)
- Fixed the playhead drifting from bars and beats above 120 BPM (#11925)
- The view no longer jumps on pause or double-click, and selecting a track by its header no longer moves the playhead (#11148, #12013, #11972 by @jonata)
- Fixed new labels being placed at the wrong position, and the first label's name not being editable right away (#11682 by @RiccardoCampo, #10083)
- No more "-9996 Invalid device" error dialog when input monitoring can't open the device (#12070, by @jonata)
- Fixed exported file names being truncated (#11966)
- Fixed opening files dropped on the macOS Dock icon (#11961)
- Fixed upper-case extensions such as .WAV not being recognized on Linux (#12007)
- Fixed shortcuts not being saved (#11903)
- Fixed tooltips on the gain, volume and graphic EQ sliders (#10410, #11841)
- Fixed the meter dB range not being translated (#11940 by @jonata)
- Cloud: fixed resuming uploads after a lost connection, mono audio imported as stereo, and broken project audio previews (#11609, #12155, #11568)
- Cloud: no more redundant sync dialog on save, error when overwriting a local copy, or half-initialized window after a failed open (#11373, #11460, #11374)
